protocol.basis: SVD of separately normalized endpoint trial columns, cutoff 1e-11 relative to largest
protocol.upper: one center Galerkin trial per equal dyadic subinterval, reused at both edges; max of convex positive trace at edges
protocol.nesting: min of the current raw piece upper and its already certified parent upper
protocol.lower: maximum of the two previously paid strict endpoint lowers, without any interior node
protocol.comparison: previous same-view 3/5/9 results; focus validation 1% replay uses saved matrices only
